mentions.name: Mathend
mentions.description: This app is a word processor positioned as an alternative to Microsoft Word, with a scientific calculator and AI integrated directly into it. It is available for Linux (stable) and Windows (unstable).
mentions.problem: Microsoft Word is unsatisfying to use; the author built a word processor that 'less sucks'.
mentions.source_excerpt: i make the microsoft word but less sucks, and there is scientific calculator integrated and also ai on it too, available on linux (stable) and windous (unstable).
mentions.author: muhamsyaddad
